awake_guard.py.diff_from_r7:
--- b9-integral-acceptance-1947726-wsl-20261011-r7/awake_guard.py
+++ b9-integral-acceptance-1947726-wsl-20261011-r8/awake_guard.py
@@ -0,0 +1,103 @@
+"""Bounded, reversible Windows idle-sleep request; never run application tests.
+
+Prepared before the r8 seal for this authorized campaign. Uses SetThreadExecutionState on
+its own thread, without changing a power plan, display policy, or W32Time.
+"""
+import argparse
+import ctypes
+from ctypes import wintypes
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import time
+
+ES_CONTINUOUS = 0x80000000
+ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED = 0x00000001
+
+def save(directory, name, value):
+    target = directory / name
+    assert not target.exists(), target
+    target.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--seconds', type=int, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--stop-file', type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if not 1 <= args.seconds <= 21600:
+        parser.error('Duration must be between 1 and 21600 seconds')
+    directory = args.output.resolve()
+    if directory.exists():
+        parser.error('Output must be a new directory; no overwrite')
+    directory.mkdir(parents=True)
+    kernel = ctypes.WinDLL('kernel32', use_last_error=True)
+    request = kernel.SetThreadExecutionState
+    request.argtypes = [wintypes.DWORD]
+    request.restype = wintypes.DWORD
+    kernel.GetCurrentThreadId.restype = wintypes.DWORD
+    flags = ES_CONTINUOUS | ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED
+    previous = request(flags)
+    if not previous:
+        raise ctypes.WinError(ctypes.get_last_error())
+    started = time.monotonic()
+    confirmed = 0
+    samples = 0
+    error = None
+    try:
+        confirmed = request(flags)
+        if not confirmed or (confirmed & flags) != flags:
+            raise RuntimeError('Own thread did not retain the requested execution state')
+        save(directory, 'control.json', {
+            'state': 'ACTIVE_API_CONFIRMED', 'pid': os.getpid(),
+            'thread_id': kernel.GetCurrentThreadId(), 'seconds_maximum': args.seconds,
+            'started_utc': time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime()),
+            'flags_requested': hex(flags), 'previous_thread_state': hex(previous),
+            'confirmation_previous_state': hex(confirmed),
+            'stop_file': str(args.stop_file.resolve()) if args.stop_file else None,
+            'heartbeat_interval_seconds': 1,
+            'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+            'global_power_policy_changed': False, 'display_policy_changed': False,
+            'W32Time_changed': False, 'application_tests_executed': False,
+            'limits': 'Idle sleep request only; user-requested sleep/lid/power button and policy overrides are not guaranteed to be prevented',
+            'documentation': 'https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/winbase/nf-winbase-setthreadexecutionstate'})
+        print('OWN_AWAKE_REQUEST_ACTIVE', flush=True)
+        with (directory / 'heartbeat.jsonl').open('w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as stream:
+            while time.monotonic() - started < args.seconds:
+                if args.stop_file and args.stop_file.exists():
+                    break
+                active = request(flags)
+                if not active or (active & flags) != flags:
+                    raise RuntimeError('Own awake request no longer confirmed')
+                stream.write(json.dumps({'utc': time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime()),
+                    'utc_epoch_seconds': time.time(), 'pid': os.getpid(),
+                    'thread_id': kernel.GetCurrentThreadId(), 'api_previous_state': hex(active)}) + '\n')
+                stream.flush()
+                samples += 1
+                time.sleep(min(1, max(0, args.seconds - (time.monotonic() - started))))
+    except BaseException as exc:
+        error = type(exc).__name__ + ': ' + str(exc)
+        raise
+    finally:
+        restore_flags = previous | ES_CONTINUOUS
+        before_release = request(restore_flags)
+        restored_state = request(restore_flags)
+        restored = bool(before_release and restored_state and restored_state == restore_flags)
+        save(directory, 'closure.json', {
+            'state': 'PASS_API_REQUEST_AND_RESTORATION' if restored and not error else 'NONPASS',
+            'seconds': time.monotonic() - started, 'pid': os.getpid(),
+            'thread_state_before_release': hex(before_release),
+            'restored_thread_state': hex(restored_state),
+            'matches_original_thread_state': restored,
+            'error': error, 'application_tests_executed': False,
+            'heartbeat_samples': samples,
+            'explicit_stop_requested': bool(args.stop_file and args.stop_file.exists()),
+            'sleep_prevention_over_15_minutes_validated': False,
+            'global_power_policy_changed': False})
+        if not restored:
+            raise RuntimeError('Own awake request restoration could not be confirmed')
+        print('OWN_AWAKE_REQUEST_RESTORED', flush=True)
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

awake_status.py.diff_from_r7:
--- b9-integral-acceptance-1947726-wsl-20261011-r7/awake_status.py
+++ b9-integral-acceptance-1947726-wsl-20261011-r8/awake_status.py
@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+"""Read the owned Windows awake heartbeat without spawning Windows processes."""
+import json
+import time
+from prepare_wsl import EVIDENCE, sha256
+
+def status():
+    try:
+        directory = EVIDENCE / 'awake-request'
+        if (directory / 'closure.json').exists() or (directory / 'stop.request').exists():
+            raise RuntimeError('Owned awake request closed or release requested')
+        control = json.loads((directory / 'control.json').read_text())
+        if control['state'] != 'ACTIVE_API_CONFIRMED':
+            raise RuntimeError('Awake request was not confirmed')
+        if control['source_sha256'] != sha256((EVIDENCE / 'awake_guard.py').read_bytes()):
+            raise RuntimeError('Awake source differs from acquired request')
+        with (directory / 'heartbeat.jsonl').open('rb') as stream:
+            stream.seek(0, 2)
+            size = stream.tell()
+            stream.seek(max(0, size - 8192))
+            complete = stream.read().rsplit(b'\n', 1)[0].splitlines()
+        if not complete:
+            raise RuntimeError('No complete awake heartbeat')
+        row = json.loads(complete[-1])
+        age = abs(time.time() - row['utc_epoch_seconds'])
+        if age > 10:
+            raise RuntimeError('Awake heartbeat stale or clock mismatch')
+        if row['pid'] != control['pid'] or row['thread_id'] != control['thread_id']:
+            raise RuntimeError('Awake heartbeat ownership mismatch')
+        if int(row['api_previous_state'], 16) & 0x80000001 != 0x80000001:
+            raise RuntimeError('Awake heartbeat does not confirm both required flags')
+        return {'state': 'ACTIVE_CONFIRMED', 'sample': row, 'sample_age_seconds': age}
+    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, RuntimeError) as exc:
+        return {'state': 'UNAVAILABLE', 'reason': type(exc).__name__ + ': ' + str(exc)}
